conditions.box: 4-CPU sandbox VM, 15.7 GB, shared with other agents' work (host load recorded in provenance)
conditions.client: Locust on the same box (benchmark/load/run.py, cold arm: every query salted, no bundle-cache hits)
conditions.corpus: empty at start; each simulated user writes its own thread, so retrieval runs over a corpus that grows from zero during the run (small)
conditions.encoders: real: granite-embedding-small-english-r2 (dense_en) + bekko-embedding-v1-a8m (dense_ml), ONNX/torch as shipped; BM25; late interaction as shipped
conditions.nli: lexical stand-in (Overrides.nli='lexical'): the ONNX NLI graph is not on this box; /v1/verify numbers do not price the NLI model
conditions.service: one API process (uvicorn, workers=1) started by scratch launcher mirroring memory-api's limits: limit_concurrency=128, backlog=2048, timeout_keep_alive=65
conditions.stores: PostgreSQL 16 direct (no PgBouncer), Qdrant 1.18.2 server, Redis db 13, filesystem blob
conditions.why_one_worker: no OpenFGA on this box: the in-process authorization stand-in (Overrides.authorization='memory') keeps grants per process, so several workers would refuse each other's threads
conditions.worker: one job worker process, worker_concurrency=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, on the same 4 CPUs
